aiPreheatPrecool.title: Suggest a preheat or precool schedule
aiPreheatPrecool.description: Ask Helix to draft a preheat or precool window grounded in the deterministic departure heuristic — start time, end time, mode (preheat | precool), and target cabin temperature. The temperatures are the same the panels below show; Helix never persists a schedule. Review the proposal and click Apply on the climate controls below to save it.
aiPreheatPrecool.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and confirm the cabin temperature, outside temperature, and departure time to draft a schedule.
